title: phlox pilosa subsp. riparia
intro: Phlox pilosa subsp. riparia, commonly known as Wood Phlox or Prairie Phlox, is a perennial flowering plant native to North America. This plant is valued for its medicinal and ornamental properties, with reported health benefits including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions due to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Phlox pilosa subsp. riparia include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce pain, and promote relaxation, making it a popular ingredient in herbal remedies. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable species in traditional medicine.
